ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Hashcat Password Cracker Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Execute Hashcat.exe with provided SAM file from registry of Windows and Password list to crack against

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\hashcat\\\.exe$") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-a\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-m\\ 1000\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-r\\ .*")))
